name: Superformula Bloom
desc: Nested Gielis superformula supershapes bloom and morph through flowers, stars, gears and sea-anemone blobs as glowing concentric contours that slowly drift and counter-rotate; renders as neon bloom, sumi ink-botanical, oil-slick iridescence, a cyan schematic blueprint, or brushed chrome.

scale.doc: bloom size / how much of the frame the supershapes fill

density.doc: number of nested concentric contours (curve richness)
